title: Compact smooth tests are Schwartz and Schwartz functions are integrable
statement: Use $\mathbf R,\mathbf C$ [def-weil-field] and Lebesgue measure on $\mathbf R^m$, $m\geq1$. A complex function $\phi$ is Schwartz if it is smooth in real coordinates and $\sup_x\|x\|^k\|D^n\phi(x)\|<\infty$ for all integers $k,n\geq0$. Every smooth complex function with compact support (the closure of its nonzero locus is compact) is Schwartz. Every Schwartz function $\phi$ is Lebesgue integrable: $\int|\phi(x)|\,dx<\infty$.
